UPCISB Cooperative Bank Various Posts Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : U.P. Co-operative Institutional Service Board (UPCISB) has released the admit card for the various posts. This recruitment was released for 2085 posts. Applications for the UPCISB UP Cooperative Bank Various Post Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 25 April 2026 to 15 May 2026. The examination is going to conducted on 17 – 21 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPCISB UP Cooperative Bank Various Post Exam Date 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 25 April 2026
  • Last Date : 15 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 15 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 17-21 September 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • For UR, OBC : Rs 500/-
  • For SC/ST : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
